ns2:section.sectionText: To register please do the following: Email program director, Heather Miller at hmiller1@uiuc.edu to be placed on the approved list to be able to register. Please email your full legal name, school name, and contact phone numbers.Once you have received a reply email from Heather with the instructions on how to register you may proceed to www.outreach.uiuc.edu to register. Do not try to register prior to receiving your approval email or you will be denied in the registration system. If you have questions about the course, please contact Heather Miller at 217-265-6568. $100 Fee per student through the FCAE contract ($825 normal price!) Note: You will be responsible for repaying FCAE if you do not complete the course. If you took NRES499CT previously, you are not eligible to take this course. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign Miscellaneous Fees $100.00 Flat Fee.
